description:
3D Sector

Required mods: None
Can be added Mid-Game?: Yes
Removing from an ongoing game: Safe

What is this?
A Utility/Conversion Mod for starsector, it is still a work in progress, especially on the graphical end since there are no premade assets, but otherwise it should be playable from start to finish.

All the weapons and systems are implemented according to vanilla values and behaviour
Shields become 3D cones. Omni shields turn toward threats on their own.
All vanilla ship systems should work with 3D VFX.
Officer skills do carry over similar to vanilla.
Command view (T) 3D tactical map, replace the vanilla "TAB" button map, uses cp just like the original with more features to suit 3D look.
Settings - Everything is in [tt]data/config/s3d_tuning.json[/tt]: key bindings, flight feel, ranges, AI and other things for fine tuning.

Screenshots

Controls

Mouse: steer
Left click: fire the selected group
Right click: shield / phase
1-7: select weapon group, Ctrl/Cmd + 1-7: toggle autofire
W / S: throttle, X: all stop
A / D: strafe, Space / Shift: up / down
Q / E: roll, L: auto-level
F: ship system, V: vent, R: lock target, Z: fighters engage / regroup
Hold Alt or middle mouse: look around, Mouse wheel: zoom
T: command view, J: spectate ([ and ] to switch ships)
Tap Cmd (Mac) or Ctrl: pause
Tab: vanilla command map (deploy reserves, full retreat)
F11: hide HUD, F9 twice: finish the battle in vanilla 2D

Compatibility and known issues
Other mods: Modded hulls, weapons and hullmods are read from the game's own data, so most of them work without changes. If 3D doesn't know a modded ship system or weapon script, the weapon still fires and deals its normal damage, but the special effect is missing. Each time the game starts, it writes [tt]saves/common/s3d_compatibility.txt.data[/tt], a list of anything from your enabled mods that doesn't fully work in 3D.
For modders: You can add support with three small CSV files. No Java is needed, and your mod won't depend on this one. See [tt]MODDING.md[/tt] in the download.

Officer personalities don't change how AI ships fight yet.
This is a beta. If a battle goes wrong, press F9 twice to finish it in 2D.

FAQ
Does this change the campaign?
No. Only the battles change. Nothing is stored in your save.

Can I play some battles in 2D?
Press F9 twice during a battle to finish it in vanilla 2D, or set battle.enabled to false in s3d_tuning.json to turn 3D off completely.

Why do the ships look like that?
Each ship's 3D shape is built from its 2D sprite when the battle loads, so every vanilla and modded ship works without needing a separate model. If you prefer a lower-fidelity look, try the retro filter.

The game runs slowly in big battles.
Press I to show the performance readout, and include it in your bug report along with the files listed below.

Looking for 3D artists
I'd love help from people who model. Ship models go into an open-source add-on, Starsector 3D - Ship Models, with your name in its credits. One ship or twenty, any help counts.

I have made some AI assisted custom models for some of the ships (around 40 in total), but to avoid the use of AI generated art i'm making this an open project where anyone can contribute to make 3D models for the ships, see the github for more info.
[/list]

What a model needs
It matches the ship's sprite seen from above, because weapons, engines and shields sit where the sprite says. A Blender script fits and scales your model to the sprite for you and reports how well it lines up.
No modelled guns. The game draws each ship's actual loadout on its mounts, so leave the mounts empty or flat.
Triangle budget: up to 80k for capitals, 40k for cruisers, 20k for destroyers, 10k for frigates.
STL, OBJ or GLB. Untextured is fine (the game paints it with the ship's sprite); a textured GLB keeps its own paint.
It's your own work, or its license allows sharing. Contributions are published under CC BY 4.0, or CC0 if you prefer.

How to take part
If you use GitHub: follow CONTRIBUTING.md and open a pull request.
If you'd rather not touch git: post a link to your model here or send me a PM with the ship and the license, and I'll fit it and add it with credit.

Say in this thread which ship you're working on, so two people don't model the same one.

Questions and ideas are welcome below.

Download Starsector 3D | Ship models repository

Attribution / Acknowledgement
Halke     The ship AI borrows ideas from AI Tweaks, rebuilt for 3D. No code was copied.
Alex and Fractal Softworks     Starsector. All ship art, sounds and fonts come from the game at runtime and are not redistributed.

AI use disclaimer
AI was used to create the Mesh Rendering and Simulation engine for the Mod, and to create Fleet AI used for 3D.
Code: Claude (Anthropic), through Claude Code

There are no AI-generated images: ship shapes are built from the vanilla sprites while the game runs.
Edit: There are at this point 57 Custom hull models made by Hyper3D rodin all of which are due to be replaced once actual human generated Models are received

Permissions
Code: Feel free to use/share it however you want.
Feedback and bug reports
Feedback and suggestions are very welcome.
For bugs, post here or report an issue. Please include your game and mod versions, your enabled mods and what happened. Attach these files from [tt]saves/common/[/tt]: [tt]s3d_last_battle.txt.data[/tt], plus [tt]s3d_last_error.txt.data[/tt] if it exists. Together they contain the battle log, your mod list and your system info.
Thanks for playing!

changelog.0.2:
A new "Retro" look, if you hate the janky voxel style of the original. It is a seperate Zip file alongside the original.
 A much much more intelligent AI, If the previous Enemy AI was a fly this one is an eagle, much more agressive and full of tricks.
 -All the officer Skills are integrated now.
